descriptionChirho: A short, pithy wisdom saying or maxim, especially as in the book of Proverbs (mishle Shelomo).
An extended figurative narrative or allegorical comparison used to illustrate a truth.
A person or nation that becomes an object of derision, cited as a warning example or taunt among the peoples.
A prophetic utterance or visionary oracle, especially the oracles of Balaam (Num 23-24) introduced as 'he took up his mashal'.
